Danny Mehta

They coordinated and resourced the removal and replacement of a 4m x 3m double glazed roof light. The move was well planned and the whole procedure went very smoothly without any incident. The plant and equipment at their disposal effectively de-risked the manoeuvre and negated the need for a huge mobile crane. Highly recommended

Gill Menage

From the initial contact to the completed works, Fluid Glass were easy to communicate with and very professional. The job needed the use of a crane and the necessary parking permits and was all organised so that the works went smoothly and with no hitches. The engineers doing the work were friendly, and very considerate - staying late one day to finish the job so that I didn’t have to make a long journey to come back to the property for another day. This was very thoughtful and much appreciated. A very good job done well!

Ellis Fraser

Fluid Glass provide a high class service and I would highly recommend them. Nothing seemed to be too much trouble and the product provided second to none. Communication with the team was outstanding, all aspects ran like clock work. Very pleased.

Verena Carmichael

Jake and his team installed large tilt and turn floor to ceiling windows for our upstairs bedrooms. We went with the hidden handles and the integrated glass balustrades and the windows create a real wow factor and the desired effect of bringing the outside into the house. We are also very pleased how smooth the opening mechanisms are given the large window size. Having used IQ Glass previously, we could not fault the service Jake and his team provided. Our project was delivered on time and installation was smooth. Both Jake and Valerio were highly responsive to our queries throughout and helped us with the design when we visited the showroom. While one specific detail got missed in the ordering process, Fluid Glass sorted this very quickly for us. Professional, highly responsive and friendly service overall. We would gladly recommend Fluid Glass.
